value.signature: fn from_guard (guard : BootstrapGuard , arguments : Value) -> Self

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter creates the one explicit command root after installation; a span here would create a second operation.

review.body: { let root = guard . 0 . as_ref () . map (| observation | { let mut root = observation . operation (OperationKind :: Command , arguments) ; root . started = Duration :: ZERO ; root }) ; Self { root , root_taken : false , _guard : guard , } }
review.item_premise: Current body preserves once-only origin transfer and level-independent accounting; release off creates no delivery machinery or closing publication.
